Pro Export

Resolution applies to the shorter side of your project format (e.g. 1080p = 1080×1920 for 9:16 or 1920×1080 for 16:9). HQ uses high-quality canvas resampling, not real AI upscaling. MP4 depends on browser and device; WebM is used if it is unsupported. Your looks, texts and keyframes are saved locally and automatically. Video files themselves stay loaded for the current session only, for privacy and storage reasons.

Say what you want

Keyword control (not real generative AI): vibe/effect names, "no blur", "auto", "transition whip", "text Hello".

Each active effect can be controlled below with its own intensity, beat reaction and time window (start/end).

Image Overlays & Backgrounds

Imported images sit as their own layers above your video. PNG transparency is preserved. The Blue Black Hole look is generated directly with a transparent canvas background.

Shoxy AI

AI settings

Get a free key

Your key stays only in this browser. If the free limit is hit, the app waits and retries, then switches to a lighter model by itself.

Reference video

The AI looks at the reference, builds your whole video, looks at its own result, compares it with the reference and fixes the differences (up to 3 rounds).

AI mode
Quick: few targeted edits, no self-review loop.

Speed

Extract sound

Pulls the audio out of the clip under the playhead and loads it as your song, so beats are analyzed and you can edit it. The clip audio is muted so nothing plays twice. Download saves the sound as a WAV file.

Fine tuning

Bright lines = bar start, thick line = drop. If the click sounds off the music, move the offset (it is remembered). Tap tempo: tap 4+ times in time; the last tap is bar 1.
